verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers natural-language Q&A about business finances ('Ask anything... in plain English') and an AI Close/Accounting AI feature, plus an MCP integration, suggesting some natural-language command capability. However, there's no evidence of broad natural-language command-and-control over the product (e.g., issuing transactional or categorization commands purely via NL beyond Q&A), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how robust this is. missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of NL command breadth, evidence of NL-driven actions beyond querying (e.g., executing categorization or reconciliation via typed commands), and details on MCP NL command scope.
